reviews.title: Requires Account
reviews.text:
Synchronizing to Omron's backend is a nice feature to have available. It is unacceptable as a forced condition of use. That makes this app useless to me.

Hardware (BP7150) itself is good, mostly easy-to-use, doesn't squeeze unnecessarily hard, is close to matching readings in clinic.

Five stars for hardware, negative stars for app.

reviews.title: Update destroyed my data
reviews.text:
Your latest update deleted ALL of my history for the last six months. Not cool! I needed that for my Cardiologist. Can it be retrieved‽ I’ve lived it up to this point.

Update November 2026…your update did this again! Last time the data came back and it better come back this time. It’s ridiculous to have your updates delete history!

reviews.title: Locks up and cant see detail, can’t add manual readings
reviews.text: While syncing might be improved, the app locks up a lot - making it unusable. The best part of app was the ability to read measurement  history in a list. Now the default is a chart - no way for user to change to measurement list display.  Now it wont allow manual temperature readings to be entered

reviews.title: Device not recognising
reviews.text: Can’t recognise through Bluetooth or find model used to work before reinstalling the app

reviews.title: Bluetooth keeps disconnecting
reviews.text: The latest version has broken the synchronization and caused me to lose history on the device twice.

reviews.title: Gets worse and worse
reviews.text: Takes forever to download readings, often doesn’t work at all. Freezes regularly. Interface makes it harder with each update to delete readings

reviews.title: Broken sync again
reviews.text: In the several years I have been using this app it has gotten steadily worse. First a number of features were removed then made available as premium features. Now ongoing and repeated sync issues. I don’t have 20 minutes to waste twice a day trying to get my EVOLV monitor to sync (which hasn’t been an issue before the latest set of app updates). Time for a more reliable brand that doesn’t increase my blood pressure by testing my patience daily.

reviews.title: Frustrating
reviews.text: What the hell have you done to this app?

reviews.title: Connection Failure @ EST
reviews.text: IDK if it was caused by iPhone setting the clock back one hour or just a glitch in the app but my second (right arm) reading wouldn’t transfer to the phone. I followed the instructions to reconnect, taking multiple readings, but they failed to appear. My BP continued to climb, not what one would want from an app measuring it! I finally had to delete and reinstall the app to get the reading to register. Ironically the readings which hadn’t shown in the app were in its history. If it happens again I will switch to a different app.

reviews.title: Broken and useless
reviews.text: Can’t pair with my Omron BP7000 units anymore.  Don’t know what they broke, but this app is now useless.

reviews.title: Going downhill
reviews.text: Used to work well but with latest update it functions very slowly, tries to keep synching continually even when the app is closed. Takes 5 minutes to finally synch.

reviews.title: Fails to sync to iPhone
reviews.text: This app is pretty terrible, all I wanted to do is pull my latest reading off my blood pressure cuff, which it won’t do 80% of the time, and if I try to sync all data, the latest reading does not appear either. I have unpaired, repaired, uninstalled, reinstalled. I don’t know who was having a good experience with this app. It seems unlikely anyone.

reviews.title: Glitchy
reviews.text: Not been able to see readings since April 26

reviews.title: Garbage NOW
reviews.text: In early 2026 the device no longer pair with my iPhone. It gave an error message about not pairing and the instructions given had you delete the current Bluetooth connection and pair again. As of November 2026 it still will not Pair. Guess it is time to buy a non Omron device and move on. My omron device is garbage. F Omron.

reviews.title: This version is terrible.
reviews.text: Won't synchronize, can't access much less download history

reviews.title: See All Measurements
reviews.text: Under history, BP, How do I make the See All Measurements appear at the top of the page instead of graphs. It was at the top of the page but was changed to have the graphs appear. I have to monitor the numbers.  The data was also different colors and now all gray which is difficult to read. The new updates are not user friendly and frustrating. I have to scroll down the page and click multiple times to get the link to open.

reviews.title: Horrible update ruined a once-simple app 😡
reviews.text: Recent updates have completely destroyed the user interface. They took away easy access to the notes section for blood pressure entries. Now you are forced to dig through multiple menus and scroll down just to add a simple memo. Even worse, after a long lag and delay, the screen only displays one short line of text and hides the rest of your note. You have to open a laggy, broken sub-menu just to read what you wrote. This is a medical tracking app—people need to log symptoms quickly and clearly. This update is a massive step backward. Please fix the notes layout and stop burying essential features behind a clunky UI!

reviews.title: Done With This App
reviews.text: Ten days ago I write a review and nothing has changed. Although I purchased a new one, the frustration of having to deal with a App that doesn’t even begin to perform like the original one that was fast and efficient, I’ve decided to delete the App and just use my Excel spreadsheet. Rest assure that I will never purchase another one of your products, since they don’t care to make the fixes to their App.

reviews.title: Latest Update
reviews.text: Can’t go into History without iPhone locking.

reviews.title: SCREENS MUCH TOO SLOW!!
reviews.text: SCREENS TAKE TOO LONG TO CHANGE!!

reviews.title: Latest App Update
reviews.text: The latest app update fixed the problem with the app freezing up every time you tried to look at individual measurements, but it made it more difficult to do simple things, like add a note or delete a reading. Both of those activities not take two steps and for folks that share the device and use notes to detect whether it’s my reading or my wife’s reading that’s a big deal.

reviews.title: Simple BP logger user interface has become slow and buggy.
reviews.text: Please revert to the old user interface. In recent weeks, this once useful app has become very slow and the user interface is worse. Recent updates has made this useful BP logger slow and the iPhone touch-screen unresponsive in the app. Another downside of recent updates is previously after syncing with the blood pressure device a user could see the 3 readings making up the latest blood pressure. Now the user must go to see all measurements to see the most recent BP detail. Changing screens causes the app to freeze. Please revert to the prior app. It was simple, intuitive, and the app did not freeze.

reviews.title: Fix your app! Syncs take forever!
reviews.text:
Newer versions of the app take several minutes to sync data with my BP meter, and then several more before they even show in the app and sync with Apple health. What’s going on? 

It isn’t getting 1 star only because the data eventually comes through. 

Eventually.

reviews.title: Export changed
reviews.text:
On version 2026-10-15….  The export feature will not export multiple times on the same day.  I take my readings in the AM and PM…. But it will only export the AM readings to Excel, CVS and PDF. 
Prior to this update… it would export multiple BP Readings for the whole day.

reviews.title: Full of bugs
reviews.text: This app is always broken. I’ve been using it for years, so I can record readings from my BP machine, but it is plagued with problems. 1) even though I have face id enabled, it prompts me for my username/password. I’ve found that if I swipe away the app and open it again, face id works. 2) I like to keep track of readings and add notes to them, the new weeks-old bug is that when I tap on the option to do that, the app freezes. The only option is to swipe it away. I no longer add notes. The only reason I use this app is because I have the machine. Time for a new machine from a different company.

reviews.title: Do not trust this app
reviews.text:
Until a week ago this would have been a four star review - for an excellent app that helped keep me safe with the odd glitch and an occasional annoying habit of not updating straight away with the latest reading, but that allowed me to wear my device under clothing & monitor my BP safely without being obvious about it. Since the last update the app has become impossible to use for real time blood pressure monitoring, rendering my expensive smart BP monitor no more effective than a cheap supermarket one (& a lot harder to read with a small led display on the device attached to my arm).  

(Update) Omron finally updated  the app a week later, (after not being able to use it helped to land me in Critical Care), sorting the freeze issue but leaving the classic apparently AI generated ‘shades of gray”, all same size fonts & difficult to read interface. However, now I can’t reconnect my device after deleting the old version of the app & downloading the new one.  Great going, Omron!!

I have autonomic disreflexia - a rare condition that raises my BP to unsustainable levels (235/120 was my highest so far - that bout landed me in the critical care unit.).  I used to use my Omron smart monitor to successfully track attacks and tell me when to take medication & when to call 999.  It turned a terrifying situation into one I had a tiny bit of control over & was a godsend. No longer. The app now freezes constantly- every time I try to change the screen - and rarely updates with new reading

reviews.title: Horribly slow, frequently changes interface
reviews.text:
The app is horribly slow and sometimes takes minutes to
come up. I suspect the connection to the server is v slow.

I have no clue why this happens, but they frequently change the interface so what you knew last week doesn’t hold any more.

The latest twist is that they have now added a detailed list of measurements and to pull up each one it takes 30 seconds.

If you want to provide an app, please do it the right way.    I suspect someone v inexperienced is running the app development, which is causing all these very basic msitakes.

reviews.title: Slower & worse. Privacy concerns.
reviews.text:
Some time back we were forced to update from the old app. We were asked  to share our health data to upload to some remote 3rd party system.  That was bad enough.  

Now September 2026 it is sooow slow, and a pain to use.  Viewing weight history is now buried underneath a compulsory graph I never want to see.   Overall dreadful. It drops the most recent readings from the all readings tab.   That is a new bug so quality control is non existent.

reviews.title: Worse and worsening
reviews.text: Omron BP instrument is excellent and reliable instrument. Unfortunately app is worsening after every update. I communicated problems with Omron support. It seems that they have no idea what is going on. Trying to push problem on my iphone - not sufficient memory. I reinstalled app in iPad - no any improvement. App is very slow and “sticky” and cannot see “all measurements” because screen is frozen. At the end - I installed it in old iPhone X. It was necessary to install an older version of app as this iPhone works with ios 16.7.12. And what a surprise - everything works fine again! Dear Omron - leave upgrades to real specialists and focus on your instruments. Upgraded versions are just pain and from bad to worse!!!

reviews.title: Bug introduced with v2026.10.01
reviews.text:
App was quite good prior to latest version which appears to have introduced a new bug.   Since the release of this version, every time I try to “show all data” from the charts/trends display, the app locks up and becomes completely unresponsive… only recourse is to force close the app.

I have tried all the suggestions I found online (stop/restart BT; Restart phone; uninstall/reinstall app,  etc) to no avail.

Email message to Tech Support has gone unanswered.

reviews.title: Blood Pressure Review
reviews.text:
OMRON makes really good blood pressure machines for the everyday person to use and I really like mine.
However, the technology side doesn’t seem to be a top priority for their app, unlike most apps that tend to be on top of updates on a regular basis.
I guess if you do well on the machine end, the technology end isn’t a priority in today’s technological world.

reviews.title: Update creates painfully SLOW history and details interactions
reviews.text: Been using this app for several years   with pretty much no issues. But the latest  UI update creates horribly slow history and details interactions.

reviews.title: Just updated and no improvement
reviews.text:
Just updated with the latest release: absolutely NO improvement to what must be the very worst app.
Every screen freezes and every command executed takes forever (that's if the app doesn't actually crash). 
It is unbelievable that an update designed to improve an utterly useless app completely fails to do so - INCREDIBLE!

reviews.title: Steven Barker
reviews.text:
Well this already flaky, unreliable and recently gimped, to allow a subscription service, app has decided it no longer wants to play. It’s stuck at log in.  I’ve tried with 3 different devices, iPad Pro I’m
, iPad Mini 4 and iPhone 12. All suffer the same problem. I put my password in, or use Face ID, and the app just pretends it’s trying to log in and does nothing. I left it to take care of something and 15 minutes later it was still “logging in”!
This is an issue that has manifested overnight, the app was working yesterday (27 Jun 23).
I wish Omron put as much effort in to the app as they do in to advertising and monitization!
UPDATE 26th Oct 2026: an update has been pushed that has rendered this flacks app utterly unusable. There is an option, in the history tab, to see all measurements. This no longer functions! I cannot see a single individual reading, only a daily average. PLEASE Omron, take this app seriously and for the love of cake properly fix it!

reviews.title: Way too many deep menus for simple tasks.
reviews.text: I have a blood pressure monitor. I need the app to sync the data. I need the data as a chart and as a simple list where I can quickly delete data points if needed. The app used to work that way but now it has more and more menus and it takes ages to delete a single reading.

reviews.title: Latest downgrade poor
reviews.text: This latest version is so slow. Trying to see all your readings is now almost impossible. It lags behind touch by at least ten seconds. Do the developers never test a new version before release? It would seem so. Great machine let down by the app which has just got less intuitive and helpful.

reviews.title: Used to be a great app, now very clunky
reviews.text: I’ve used this app for over five years. Loved it, especially the ability to put in notes in the blood pressure daily readings. In the last two months or so though, the changes to the app have made it extremely hard to use, I have “synchronization” issues daily, and entering notes in the daily reading is extremely hard to do now. I don’t know why this all changed, but it’s very unfortunate, as it turned a great app into a marginal one.

reviews.title: APP UPDATES ARE HORRIBLE
reviews.text: Refresh the old app. The latest updates over the past few months are horrible and are no longer user friendly. I wish there was a better BP cuff available because I would toss this in a heartbeat because the app is so bad now!

reviews.title: Bush league app
reviews.text: I have used OMRON devices daily for the past six years.  This app is always buggy.  For example, readings won’t transfer even though the app says they have.  Moving between functions within the app is slow and balky.  History sometimes loads and sometimes doesn’t.

reviews.title: OMRON made it worse!
reviews.text: Update: I did not think OMRON could make this app any worse but you did! Want to see your BP history? Tap and wait. Wait some more. Get a cup of coffee. Wait. Ok, there’s my history. Want to add a Note to a reading?? Tap and wait. Refill your coffee. Wait. Wait a bit more…. Clearly OMRON’s and its developers have turned a once decent app from good to feces.

reviews.title: Sync
reviews.text: Mine is constantly not syncing with the app on my phone nor MyHealth. Otherwise it’s fine.

reviews.title: Worthless APP
reviews.text: Will not respond to trying to change views. Terrible app. The last  two or  three updates have constantly been a downgrade in app functionality. I think it’s time to buy a different BP monitor. One that actually has an app that works.

reviews.title: No connection
reviews.text: Always the same problem that is being seen by my phone and syncing; Simply rubbish; If you can’t save your measurements on the phone, what is the point?

reviews.title: Recent Update
reviews.text: I have been having issues with the app since the recent update. It’s freezing, the sync hasn’t been syncing.. It is quite annoying when you have to document your BP history. Please fix ASAP or I will delete.

reviews.title: Declining functionality
reviews.text:
Each new release to change appearance introduces new bugs. Quality of this once functional app has steadily declined. 

Synch’s with BP761N are slow and sometimes non-existent. 

“All Measurements” take forever to load. 

Cannot add notes to readings with newest release. If you finally get to a screen where you can add notes, the notes are applied to the wrong entry!

Manual entry of weights defaults to date instead of weight. 

If the problem is too many data points, you should provide a mechanism to batch delete entries after export rather than just one entry at a time.

Sometimes the old version shows up. Would that it would only stay.

reviews.title: Can no longer look at BP history
reviews.text: I have always been able to see BP history and delete the outliers. Since the last update if I try to go into history the application will just freeze up! It sucks!!!!

reviews.title: Won’t stay connected
reviews.text: This app worked great, for a while. Now it will not stay connected with Apple Health. Each time I take a measurement I must open the OMRON app, disconnect from Apple health and reconnect to get readings to transfer. There is no means of contacting anyone for support, this the reason for this review.

reviews.title: The Omron connect App used to be great but not anymore
reviews.text: Have been using the App for many years since the previous version. It used to be great in the past but it no longer works properly anymore. There was significant delay in feeding the data into the App recently. Now I’m even no longer able to access the past data at all. It just stops at the menu page.

reviews.title: Still having issues and getting worse.
reviews.text: App still having issues to sync automatically, have to press save 3-4 times on manual entries for them to actually save (and yes, all of the saves appear listed and have to erase the extra saves) and now when sync is complete can’t add notes and app freezes.

reviews.title: Doesn’t connect with BP Monitor
reviews.text: I just got a new monitor and the app doesn’t even connect with it. It finds it, but comes up with an error every time. Useless.

reviews.title: Updates
reviews.text: Every time they update the App it gets progressively worse. Two years ago it was perfect. Put it back like it was and quit messing with it! The last update is ridiculous!!!!

reviews.title: The app has password issues
reviews.text: I can’t get to the point where I can log in, and the password reset doesn’t seem to work.

reviews.title: Never keeps my login information!!!!
reviews.text: I don’t want to use an easy password for highly confidential medical information but this app is always asking for me to login.

reviews.title: Can’t connect to the BP monitor
reviews.text: Since the latest update I can no longer connect to the BP monitor!!

reviews.title: App deteriorated
reviews.text: This app has deteriorated. It regularly fails to connect with Bluetooth on my iPhone 16 Pro. It currently won’t open the list of results and the screen freezes when it tries to do so. I don’t whether this is due to upgrade in the OS of iPhone or the app but it needs fixing.

reviews.title: App gets slower and harder to use with every update
reviews.text:
Latest version barely usable it is so slow (iPhone 16 Pro Max). Interface never great, now trash. Must go from current reading to history to whole separate page to blood pressure, weight or temperature (these last two are trivial items not measured by your devices and selecting bp brings up graphs with no notes, and from there you have to go to “all readings” which finally brings up a list— very slowly. After that you can touch an individual reading in the list where you at last see a box where you can enter a note. But the only button on the page is Cancel — you have to hit back arrow to save note. Non standard and annoying plus also slow. Finally you see the note in the item in the text list— but not the device for example. To see that you have to go back to the details page where you entered the note. The previous list had all the basic stuff in the list entry and was faster.
Please do better!

reviews.title: SUCKS!
reviews.text:
I have the 7465. It averages 3 readings. Problem is the “See All Measurements” page is frozen and will not open. 
I read online that the update has moved that info!! But I sure cannot find it. I have tried AI! Not easy to follow. Tried their steps and still no luck. Extremely fed up with Omron. Nonstop issues with their app. Maybe ya’ll need to be fired and replaced with people who know what they are doing! Just saying….😡

reviews.title: Update has interfered with syncing
reviews.text: Am getting sync errors since your app update. Also HATE that when I click on HISTORY, I only get a silly graph with one reading. Then I have to click on something else to get all data. That’s a real time waster for someone who does multiple reading a day. Wish you hadn’t changed how the app works.

reviews.title: Spare me
reviews.text:
UPDATE 10/22/2026: the app now freezes whenever you try to press on the “See all measurements”. Contacted OMRON days ago and still no update. Spent at least 30 minutes giving them screenshots, logs, etc. I wish they could go back to the previous version before the major interface changes. 

I wish there was an option in the App Store to see review ratings of just the latest update because if that possibility existed everyone would see that their actual rating MIGHT be 2 stars, or
More likely 1.5 stars. Pitiful changes to a working app have made a lot of people very upset. Check for yourself by sorting reviews by “most recent”. 1-star ratings far outnumber any others. You’d think that the folks at OMRON would see that and take action to fix the app. The one 5-star review I saw was by a user named “Shill1986” and if you don’t know what a shill is, you should look it up. Horrible update and they should be ashamed of themselves. Also there is no way to contact support like there used to be. Pitiful.

reviews.title: Too Slow
reviews.text: Trying to delete readings is an absolute nightmare. You have to do it individually and it takes FOREVER. My phone overheats every single time. Please fix this. iPhone 18 Pro Max with latest iOS for reference.

reviews.title: Latest updates are CPU hogs
reviews.text: Why does it take 20 minutes and 8% of my fully charged battery to take four readings and delete two of them?? This app gets worse and worse with every update. Get someone competent to profile the code performance!

reviews.title: This year updates problems
reviews.text: Every update is getting worse at syncing the readings. Last update consistently is missing one readings out of two. Pushing for manual sync does not help. The readings are not transferred to the phone saying no more readings. It takes also a huge amount of time to move from home screen to the historical readings or back. Still  no improvements after two weeks. I have two devices, one nightview and one evolv both showing the same problem with syncing. Still garbage app . All recordings freezing the app.

reviews.title: Awful “upgrade”
reviews.text: Latest version a disaster!  Cannot easily sync and review 3 measurements to retain 1 - as recommended!  Previous version of app was far better!

reviews.title: Non functional
reviews.text: The “see all readings” history burn dos not work

reviews.title: New update freezes up
reviews.text: When I look at blood pressure history & press see all measures, everything freezes.

reviews.title: App freezing up after sync
reviews.text: After last update app is freezing after sync.

reviews.title: Laggy and probably collecting your info
reviews.text: Well, the app definitely tracks your blood pressure readings from the monitor, but it’s very laggy and glitchy. This makes me think that they’re loading all of your data on a server in the cloud somewhere versus on your phone. If you value your privacy, you may want to select a different product.

reviews.title: Inconsistent at best
reviews.text: This thing only works half the time. Gives random errors for no reason at all. I sit perfectly still with my arm on the table, resting on a pillow, and this piece of junk keeps insisting that I’m moving around and it cannot get a good reading.

reviews.title: Recent changes suck
reviews.text: October of 2026 and the app just started freezing when I tried to look at all the measurements option. Just lost years of BP data and notes and of course I have a Dr appointment today. Absolutely do not recommend this app or Omeron devices. No way to import my old data either. As of May 2026 they have made changes to the app that make it less functional and less user friendly. I used to be able to choose the list vs the chart display for my bp. Now it forces me to see the chart every time and I have to scroll down and manually select the list option every time. It makes it harder for my Dr to look at too. I liked to old display and options better.

reviews.title: History not working
reviews.text: I’m no longer able to view previous blood pressure readings

reviews.title: Terrible update
reviews.text: It does not display any user error in taking the reading, unless you dig into the app. You have to navigate to your history and then click on the most recent reading to see if it was measured correctly. This should display on the very first reading screen, as it is an important determination as to whether the reading is accurate or not.

reviews.title: Buggy, developer unresponsive on issues
reviews.text:
Update 10/20/26: still one of the most buggy and frustrating apps I ever have ever dealt with. I can’t believe I have to fight with an app that is supposed to track my blood pressure!

I have been using various versions of this app for several years now. The latest version is very buggy and erratic. It frequently locks up, and there actually seems to be two completely different versions of the app that will show up when you launch it - one that seems more of a consumer app, and one that seems more clinical, but there is no way to make it stay with one or the other, and when it launches one way, there is no way to get it to switch back to the other until it decides to launch that way again sometime. I have sent help requests to the developer twice now describing the issues, and have never received a response. Very frustrating to fight with an app in the middle of trying to take your blood pressure!!

reviews.title: App is lacking
reviews.text: The OMRON machine works well.  However, the app is not at all good.  Since the app was redesigned it sometimes won’t sync and when it does it takes a while for the new numbers to show up.  History freezes and is very glitchy..  need work!

reviews.title: 2026 10.01 update less useful
reviews.text:
This update changes blood pressure measurement list display making it less useful at a glance by ‘stacking’ reading characteristics and instead forcing users to view details and add notes by following the > and removing the swipe to delete function.

These changes are a step backward for users. I can’t imagine any consistent user of the blood pressure app would support these changes and question whether any user testing was done.

reviews.title: App is not responsive
reviews.text: The app is responding intermittently

reviews.title: With every update, it gets worse.
reviews.text:
With the newest update, they destroyed the “View all measurements” screen. It’s a sloppy mess and much harder to read. You can’t expand the notes in this view any longer either.

The reporting has stopped working altogether. Downloadable reports and email reports stopped working. I’m now left with no good way to get reports to my doctors. 

On top of that, you can no longer log symptoms/notes with your blood pressure readings. Forced to switch platforms/cuffs to a different brand. Omron has become useless.

reviews.title: Connectivity issues
reviews.text: It is not connecting to HEM 7600T. While the same device is connecting to other paid apps

reviews.title: Removed the ability to delete bad BP readings
reviews.text:
Latest update took away the option to delete errant entries. Before, if a reading was off, I could remove it easily from the all measurements section. Now it stays in my history and skews my averages and trends.

I do not know what kind of third-rate product manager removes a user's ability to manage their own data, but this is unacceptable. A blood pressure log is only useful if it is accurate. Wonky readings happen from a loose cuff, a bad position, or talking mid-measurement. Forcing users to keep them makes the whole record less reliable, and that is the opposite of what a health app should do.

This is my data. I should control it. Until this is fixed, I am moving to a different brand and app.

reviews.title: Can’t write notes!
reviews.text: There is no option on the unit or in the app to jot notes! I spent 20 minutes on the phone only for the lady to put me on hold for her to find out with her supervisor that they are aware of this problem and working on fixing it but couldn’t give me a time frame of when the fix would happen. Must return and find a unit from a different company as my dr wants to know whether I had just taken meds or worked out or what I had eaten and such.

reviews.title: Updates this year have made this app GARBAGE
reviews.text: It’s time to roll the clocks back in this app by a year. You can no longer see the individual measurements when using the true read feature now. Users are also unable to delete individual readings in the history.

reviews.title: Removed needed functions
reviews.text: The mid-October update appears to have removed all editing and manual entry functions. I don’t enter data exclusively through OMRON, and I want to be able to add entries, notes and remove erroneous or incorrect readings. Unacceptable.

reviews.title: Keeps freezing
reviews.text: The latest app update has resulted in the app constantly freezing which means it’s not possible for me to see the individual readings. This has become a useless app and I will aim to replace my device with a different one as soon as I can.

reviews.title: App no longer works
reviews.text: Despite 5 blood pressure readings taken, the app claims there are no readings. The app has been flaky. Now, it has simply failed.

reviews.title: Frustrating App
reviews.text: I like the OMRON blood pressure monitoring hardware, but the supporting App is consistently getting worse with every update. What started out as an excellent App several years ago, it just gets slower and slower, and you can’t do anything else on your phone whilst it is trying to sort itself out otherwise you start all over again. Example, after this mornings update, 30% battery gone, 2 hours waiting, still not finished sorting itself out.

reviews.title: Notes
reviews.text: No longer allows the addition of notes to bp readings.

reviews.title: Pos
reviews.text: Screw this app and its developers.

reviews.title: Used to be Great
reviews.text: This app used to be totally functional and great. Now I can’t delete measurements or add notes. So if someone else uses my device, their measurement is in my history permanently without a way of me noting that it’s not mine.

reviews.title: No ability to add notes or see individual readings for the average
reviews.text: As of this morning the app has taken away the ability to see the individual readings for a three-reading average. I’ve lost the ability to add notes as well as aFIB readings no longer show up in my history. As someone who frequently has a significant difference in the reading of my left versus the right arm the ability to notate that as well as how I’m feeling at the time is paramount in my treatment and sharing the data with doctors. I don’t know why the developers decided to remove the feature but add it back PLEASE!!!!

reviews.title: STOP MESSING AROUND!
reviews.text: Another update.. Gee, thanks! What have you done to the app now? It’s meant to be”fixed”, is it? Now the section for entering notes has disappeared, and I can no longer add new ones.. as this is where I save my blood glucose readings, I’m unable to track that any more, so thank you SO much for that. For heavens sake stop messing around with the app, which a month ago functioned reasonably. This is our medical history you are stuffing around with, not a game of Flappy Bird. I am so tired of opening this app to discover what joys you’ve inflicted on us with your latest “improvements”. I NEED THOSE NOTES. And the symptom logger has been missing for a month, which is equally annoying, though not quite as vital (for me, anyway.. others may be more affected). Whoever is in charge at your app development needs firing, because they are destroying your reputation, and ruining our primary health app. For heavens sake, sort it out, and don’t take another month to do it!

reviews.title: BP Notes History & Add Notes Disappeared!
reviews.text:
I have been using this app for over 3 years. I have been in a hypertensive crisis for the past 4 weeks and have been faithfully tracking my BP WITH NOTES for context for my doctor who is using the readings AND NOTES to tweak and adjust my BP med dosages and parameters. Now I can no longer see my notes history, nor does the app have the Add Note or Edit Note features anymore! 

Why in the world would you eliminate such important features from this app?! I have literally been using this app and my Omron wrist cuff to get through a terribly frightening crisis, and I wake up today to the app that took away one of its most important features for my use of it! Now THAT will raise a patient’s BP even more! 

The app is useless if I have to document contextual notes elsewhere in another app (like a Notes app) per BP reading. It is stressful enough to be in the midst of medically trying to stabilize and regulate my BP again, and now I have lost the ease of documenting in-the-moment notes all in one place. 

As a software engineer myself, this change in usability is completely unacceptable for the user and renders the app essentially unusable for the purposes I have stated in this review. I cannot tell you how disappointed and upset I am at this removal of functionality!

Still not recommended. Time to move away from this neglected brand. 

Apr 2026: the latest release of the app is even worse than the last. This company has some good hardware but they have no idea what they are doing with the software. I could recommend the hardware to a family member or friend but I would never do that because the software is continually poor and they would struggle to synchronise and update each time they use the hardware. However, one positive is the report that the App generates. I showed it to my doctor and he was very impressed with it. It is just a pity they can’t get the software right. Not recommended.

reviews.title: Good hardware, very poor app and unreliable syncing
reviews.text:
OMRON’s App Store description advertises automatic Bluetooth synchronisation, integration/exchange with Apple Health, and Premium features including earning Rewards for consistent tracking. 

Good OMRON hardware completely let down by the app!

I use an OMRON X7 Smart and have generally been happy with the actual blood-pressure monitor. Unfortunately, the OMRON connect app is a completely different experience.

Bluetooth and data synchronisation are extremely unreliable. I can take several blood-pressure readings with my iPhone beside the X7 Smart, Bluetooth enabled and the device showing as connected, yet the readings do not reliably synchronise.

The same problem affects data connected through Apple Health and Apple Watch. Weight, temperature and other health data can already be present in Apple Health, with all permissions and connections enabled, but OMRON Rewards can still show zero.

On one recent day I received only 625 out of 4,825 available Rewards points. Of those, 600 were for medication tracking and 25 simply for opening the app once (when I had in fact opened and closed it several times). Blood pressure, activity, weight, ECG, temperature and oxygen all recorded zero in Rewards despite measurements or data being available.

The app used to be OK. However, it is now broken. The app wants me to sign in again but the sign in button is dithered. reviews.title: New Update Makes Adding Notes Painfully Slow Since 8.5.0
reviews.text:
I’ve been using the Omron app for a long time, and the usability took a major step backward starting with version 8.5.0. The “New Home Screen” update introduced a workflow change that makes adding notes significantly more difficult than before.

Previously, I could add a note directly from the main screen. Now, when I tap a reading, the app takes about 10 seconds to load — and it always loads the chart first. I don’t need the chart, and I don’t use the chart for adding notes, yet I’m forced to see it every single time I want to annotate a reading. After that delay, I have to scroll down to “See all measurements,” but the scrolling is laggy and often requires several swipes before the app responds. Only after selecting “See all measurements” can I scroll again, enable “Show notes,” and finally add a note. This is a clear usability regression.

This change affected me during a medically sensitive moment. I was recently hospitalized for a stroke, and I rely on the ability to quickly annotate readings when symptoms or stress occur. The new slow, chart‑first workflow made it harder to document an important reading in real time, which is unacceptable for a health‑tracking app.

Omron should restore the ability to add notes directly from the main screen or streamline the workflow. Users who depend on this app for real medical situations should not be forced to wait through delays, laggy scrolling, and an unnecessary chart just to record essential information.

reviews.text: I have been using this OMRON BP5250 for a couple of years now and for the most part, it does a great job recording my blood pressure and pulse.  However, I wish there was a way to summarize my average Bp for each day.  I generally take my bp 10 times to get a good idea of my bp since it can jump around.  My biggest issue now is with the Bluetooth not working properly and connecting my iPhone to the bp machine.  It either takes way too long to sync or it does sync via Bluetooth at all.  I have updated the software twice and I have also unpaired and paired the iPhone with the machine on a few occasions.  The fact that I am starting to have these problems is causing my bp to really increase now.    This software update seems to be riddled with problems and is becoming unreliable.  Please go back to the original software version I had when I bought this bp machine.

reviews.title: Confusing setup
reviews.text:
I’m pretty tech savvy, but I’m unclear how the sync process is supposed to work. And connecting to Apple Health app was a pain. 

I have auto-sync turned on in this OMRON app, but I only notice a sync occurring between the BP monitor and the app when I manually tap the double-arrow sync button. I don’t notice anything happening automatically. 

Also, I found the process to share data with Apple Health to be confusing. I kept seeing a message in the OMRON app telling me it wasn’t fully configured, and I could see that systolic & diastolic data was not being passed along. Only after tapping the Apple Health icon in the OMRON app several times did I discover that I needed to tap a button *under* the icon. This is not intuitive. I was also told that I had to go to the Apple Health app to finish the process, but it didn’t tell me how to do so. I eventually found it in Blood Pressure > Data Sources > Edit button, then checking the *second* OMRON connect item, listed under Data Sources. 

I hope OMRON considers re-testing the usability of the UI and documentation more thoroughly and makes some improvements. This is cool technology, but it should be designed to be more intuitive and user friendly.

reviews.title: KISS
reviews.text:
The previous app was simple and easily linked to hardware (we have the scales and BP devices) - the old app have a simple interface to transfer readings and feed into the native health app.  This new version is trying to be a total health monitoring app - and failing the user who just wants an ongoing record of their readings.  Syncing is slow and seems to be looking for all devices when the app is started (and for us, usually fails).
I don’t like the nags for subscribing - I’m not a hypochondriac.
If OMRON want to market a full service, offer two apps - one for the full subscription deal and a second, simpler, one that just provides the interface.
Update (May 26): The latest update has simplified it (which I like) but doesn’t have any way (that I can see) to customise what it now shows.  My home screen includes measures it once copied from the Apple Health app I don’t need it to show (and is data from several years ago).  Since I can’t remove it, I’ve tried allowing it to update from the Health app in settings, so the data is at least current, but it doesn’t.  Maybe I’m fussy.
Update (June 26): Brilliant!  Today’s update has lost all my data.

reviews.title: Bad update could kill
reviews.text:
I suffer from a severe adrenal insufficiency that often causes abrupt blood pressure and cardiac surges that can reach hypertensive crisis stage in mere minutes. This new “upgraded design” is downright dangerous. In an emergency, I don’t need vastly smaller text to to try to read in a sea of wasted white space, I don’t need to search or perform extra steps for my list view history, I don’t need to search for the formerly obvious hypertension rating chart, I don’t need irrelevant marketing pop-ups, and I don’t need developer excuses. 

This new design should be immediately abandoned in favor of a full restoration of the previous app design, and whomever launched this heinous death trap of a design should be fired. Minutes and seconds matter to patients - they can make the difference between life and death. You had a lifesaving app in the previous design. This one has the potential to be a deadly curse.

reviews.title: Completely worthless and unreliable
reviews.text:

When the memory is full, you can keep trying to make it work by turning it on and off (all you can do with only two buttons). Then it will show something on the screen but is it yesterday’s reading or today’s? Is it high because you have a problem or because you have had to take your blood pressure five times in a row?
The customer service is nonexistent. And only having two buttons. It has been impossible to pair with a device as the directions to pair with a device only count through the memory. 
Buy something else while you still can.

reviews.text:
The latest update is extremely disappointing. Before this update, I could clearly view both the graph and my historical weight readings. Now, when checking my weight trend, I can only see the graph, with no clear access to the detailed historical records or actual numbers that used to be available.

This is a serious downgrade in usability. For a health tracking app, historical readings are not optional — they are the whole point. A graph alone is not enough. Users need to see the actual dates and weight values to track progress properly.

Please restore the previous historical data view or provide a clear list/table of past readings. This update has made the app much worse, not better.

reviews.title: Removed Notes fand History table view
reviews.text: As of 8.5.1 and 8.6.0 it is no longer possible to click on a reading that was just taken to get to the History table of BP readings. That, as well as the Blood Pressure tile on the History tab, now only show the Chart view. The blue List button that has been at the top-right corner of the Chart view for 8+ years is now gone. Clicking on a value on the chart does nothing. The only way to get to the History table view is now to open the Chart, scroll all the way to the bottom of the page, and then click See all measurements. It now takes four taps and a long scroll to get to the Add Note screen, when it used to take one tap and no scrolling. My doctor wants me to take notes with each BP reading (waking, after meal, etc) and I have been using this feature for months. Burying the Notes feature under so much obfuscation makes it nearly useless. Please make it easy to add Notes to each BP reading as I’m taking it like it was for many years before this release.

reviews.title: Needs fixing!
reviews.text:
I really want to like the OMRON connect app because the hardware itself is Solid but the app seriously let it down.

First off the constant push toward premium features is frustrating. I’ve already paid for the device – the app should feel like a seamless extension of that not something that keeps trying to upsell me. It cheapens the experience and makes it feel like I’m being monetised twice.

The biggest issue though is the login experience. There’s clearly a bug that forces you to sign in far too often – in my case, basically every day that alone is annoying but it’s made worse by the way the login is designed. Splitting email and password across two separate screens brakes iOS password auto Phil, so the built-in password manager doesn’t recognise the login properly. That means manually entering credentials over and over, which feels completely unnecessary in 2026.

This could be fixed pretty easily, put email and password on the same screen so iOS auto Phil works properly, and add Face ID Support so repeated logins aren’t such a pain. Ideally, fix the bug that logs uses out so frequently in the first place.
Right now, the app feels like an afterthought compared to the hardware. With a few usability fixes, it could be much better.

reviews.title: Refuses to Auto Sync Measurements
reviews.text:
Updated: App constantly logs me out. At this point, since auto sync doesn’t work, and it won’t stay logged in, there’s no real reason to keep the app on my phone. 

Original: This app needs some serious help.  Count me among the many others that used the Omron Wellness (happily) and shifted to this new travesty of an app. Premium features and reduced functionality abound! I want one thing out of this app... Auto sync my BP measurements. Maybe I'm lazy, maybe I'm expecting too much out of an app setting, but I never had an issue with the old app. Please fix the auto sync function and I'll over look the obvious plot to hide functionality behind a paywall. As for the complaints of monthly reports, I just push everything to Apple Health. I know a lot of folks haven't had such luck, but mine is working so there is hope on that front.

reviews.title: Can’t Sync now the icon has been replaced with share
reviews.text: This used to be a great app. But recently i’m having problems syncing with my device (x4Smart). The auto sync has always been inconsistent and often just didn’t work. The new version relies more on auto-sync which is such a daft thing, particularly as it is so unreliable. I want to be able to manually sync from the history page. Like I’ve always done. I know have to navigate to my profile, click device, click sync all data. Then i get a Sync failed message which i have to click to get the data in the app. But as of today, it is not syncing at all. So i am finding the app useless. Put the sync button back where it was and sort out the syncing issues.

reviews.title: OMRON Deliberately Destroyed a Functional App
reviews.text:
This app was genuinely useful: BP history, selectable time-scale averages, clinically meaningful data to share with your physician. After the recent update, all of that is gone — and so is every reading I had prior to January 1 of this year.
OMRON’s update deleted my historical health data.
The period average — the single most important BP statistic, the number your cardiologist actually wants — has been removed and replaced with a min/max range that is clinically useless. Meanwhile, a paid subscription tier has materialized. This is not a coincidence.
I paid a premium for a connected device expecting functional data management. OMRON unilaterally revoked that to extract a recurring fee from customers who already paid for the product. Hundreds of App Store reviews confirm I’m not alone.
Restore the averaging function. Restore user history. Stop treating paying customers as a revenue extraction target. One star is generous.

reviews.title: Ok at first, but….
reviews.text: Has worked well since I bought an X7 blood pressure monitor a few months ago. Last used 10th April 2026 and all was well, but today it’s stopped syncing data to the app. Whilst it appears in the Bluetooth iPhone connections list it just won’t connect properly. If it does connect it drops out almost immediately. I’ve unpaired then re-paired several times. Also deleted the app then reinstalled. Logged out then back in again, but nothing has fixed it so now having to record readings manually 🙄. Just glad I didn’t purchase the premium option.

reviews.title: What happened to easy to use app????
reviews.text: My app updated this morning and the new format is absolutely horrible!  It now takes no less than four steps to add a new weight and the app is very slow to connect by Bluetooth to my machine to update my BP reading. I do not like opening the app and anyone nearby can see my weight on the main screen now!  Go back to the old format that was simpler and more pleasing to the eye please!  Also, I just updated my app to the current version and now my Face ID login is gone and now I must login daily by physically entering my user ID, select enter and then I have an option to use my password app to select the password. Previously, once I activated the FaceID my app automatically logged in daily with no extra typing or selecting anything.  Now the app has taken a massive step backwards in technology as well as appearance.  Now it feels as if a child developed the app and it’s very labor intensive to use for customers.  Please bring back the old format!!

reviews.title: Home screen Ruined your app
reviews.text: 5 days ago your programmers over thought the home screen. Perhaps not thinking. I have been using the omron7000 for years, twice a day for doctor monitoring blood pressure. The Home screen had a centered  nice large colored numbers FOCUSED on the Bp! That is the entire reason for the app. Yes other devices can be attached, but now the home screen is just another awful boring list of small characters ALREADY available under the history tab. Whatever metric measured should be big bold center of the home screen. That is completely gone. You idiots. The large center full screen bp image was immediately available. I’d rather buy your competitors product now. You killed this app Bring back the large center landing page. It’s the whole idea of monitoring your numbers with a large center of the screen home page of the metric one is measuring.

reviews.title: Love the products!
reviews.text:
Love the products and how easy it is to have everything auto feed in to an app.
How ever I do not love the new update. I liked being apple to see things on the one page all set out and obvious in different colours for the relevant section. Everything is now all one colour and mixed up and. It easily identifiable, and I had to trudge through the app to find where to log my medications as they are no longer on the front screen when logging in and can’t be added! Fix the new update, it’s awful!

reviews.title: Accessing Reports Very Difficult!!
reviews.text: I cringe whenever my doctor wants me to send her a BP report.  This app is EXTREMELY unreliable.  Sometimes it will give me the correct date range, sometimes not.  (There are two different places to enter the date range and it’s not clear which is the right one to use.) Most recently, the report said no reading in my date range when it was clear looking in the app that there were over 30 readings. And it’s not a simple matter of just seeing something is wrong and correcting it - Omron makes you wait a long time, a half hour or more, before the report arrives by email, and even that is an iffy proposition- maybe half the time they never show up at all.  If i wanted to get picky, I’d complain that the pdf report is poorly designed taking 5, 6, or even more pages to display data that could easily be displayed in a simple one page table.  I suppose it is nice that the Omron device at least keeps a record of the past readings.  This has been very handy on the multiple occasions where i had to give up on the app and compile the data with pencil and paper.  It is clear that the data, at least at some point, are available to my ipad.  Why can’t you either have a simple DIRECT share to file on the device,or even a compact table you can screen print?  Ok, I’d better end this now.  I have to spend the next 20 minutes transcribing data because the stupid app has not yet sent me anything useful I can deliver to my doctor.

reviews.title: When it works its good
reviews.text:
When this app works it’s brilliant. Completely hands free updates direct from the blood pressure cuff. However since the last iOS update it tells you it’s transferred the values but click on it and there’s nothing there. Ask it to sync and it comes back with no new items. Restart the app it’s still not there. Do a second reading and that transfers fine. So every time I now have to do a complete data transfer from the profile menu. I contacted support and got the usual de/reinstall which worked for the next reading and then back to square one. They seemed happy to say use the full data sync which I don’t really want as my partner has a few of his high readings on my profile but I have no choice. 

Guys. Check the new iOS update. I can’t be the only one with issues!

reviews.title: You get what you pay for
reviews.text:
Probably works well if you take out their costly premium subscription, but otherwise its just a bit better than pen and paper. 
Without the subscription, it will record your readings over time, but using “share” is useless. It pretends to share / export the data as a PDF, CSV or Excel according to what you choose, saying “Your report was successfully shared” to your nominated email address. In fact, it has actually done no such thing! Asking it to generate a screen report gives a message saying “a report is being generated and you will receive an alert”. No alert ever arrives.
Calling the UK helpline I discover that that these are only available to premium subscribers. Clicking on the “find out more” (about premium) also does nothing!
The meter itself does not allow multiple users, which most other similar BP devices do, so another weakness. Ho hum. I will just have to manually transcribe all info for my GP, dull, but for two weeks per year, it isn’t worth paying for premium for my use case.

reviews.title: Use a notepad or diary instead
reviews.text: I have owned and used Omron BP monitors for over a decade. I've owned numerous monitor types and models. Other than the wrist being a less than optimal measuring spot for the wrist models, I have only ever had one consistently annoying issue, the app. When the app works, it's great. Problem is, far too often it doesn't work. Bluetooth is the issue. I decided to write this review after wasting the past twenty minutes trying to sync the app and monitor to document high BP and a high heart rate. The sync kept searching and failing on the device and in-app. I finally ended up just entering the data manually into notes on my phone, which I will continue doing moving forward. I could manually record it in the app, but I've lost all faith in it. I'm trying to monitor major health issues. I don't have time to deal with unreliable apps commissioned to the lowest bidder to maximize profits. And it's not like this issue is new. I've experienced intermittent bluetooth issues on all my Omron devices for years. It's honestly a dice roll whether it will work at times.

reviews.title: All good but: ECG isn’t compatible with Apple Health or pay for OMRON Connect
reviews.text:
The most expensive £120+ OMRON device doesn’t sync its ECG days to Apple health hence the 2-star.
App Store isn’t having a screen sit section, if we go to the Health —> Summary —> Profile —> Apps —> OMRON Connect —> Data from OMRON Connect; we can see that there isn’t ECG data. This is a bummer as otherwise we have to pay for OMRON Connect. All service providers are forcing these days to store in their own bespoke cloud systems and letting consumers forget the number of subscriptions one has over a period of time. Especially medical devices are used by elderly who would have no clue. Hard to believe the developers works have intentionally missed this!

reviews.title: Ok but bad navigation bug
reviews.text:
Generally app is OK. Sync works good. Export works good. However periodically it will fail to show the menu across the bottom to let you navigate. You can't get to your history there's just a white bar across the bottom. This typically happens to me when I take a new blood pressure reading and then I open the app I see the reading I just took but then the navigation selections at the bottom are completely missing.

Other than that it's just a little busy trying to "be everything health tracker" I wish you could turn off / hide the functions that you're not using although I know Omron wants us to buy more devices.  I also wish that "show all notes" was the default setting. I have to go in and turn that on just about every time - I always wanna see my prior notes.
